name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 10 - Am 3
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 10a. Calls on the Council and the Commission to stop financing non-governmental organisations (NGOs) that are complicit in facilitating illegal migration; underlines that private entities must not engage in search and rescue operations in breach of national laws; reiterates that funding to such organisations, which effectively operate as illegal shuttle services for migrant smuggling, should be blocked; reiterates its call to hold these NGOs criminally liable for human smuggling and trafficking;
